line.comment: * Outposts are destroyed, factories are transferred. All wares are transferred to a random outpost.
* Add-Ons 1.10.2: Fix edge case with unknown sectors (used by Phanon and Yaki arrival): if the sector is unknown, then it must be conquered instead.
* Pick a random outpost to transfer wares to.
* Herobetty 4.5: Stock exchange is not transferred to the owner (special case if buying a Teladi sector containing the stock exchange).
* Add-Ons 1.10.2: Let the stock exchange be transferred over unless the sector is being transferred over to the player.
* Transfer all wares to another outpost.
* Destroy the station and recreate it. Way more easier than to transfer it.
